findings.detail: Lane A emits project/roots/files/symbols/imports/annotations, not E feed nodes/edges/provenance; needs scoped source-pinned lowering
Lane B emits project with numeric HQ project id plus records/links/unknowns; E requires one string projectId, nodes/edges and fully qualified source provenance; must preserve unknown links
Lane C emits operations/CLI with semanticId:null and handler source statuses; E requires source-owned nodes and explicitly linked semantic_id; never assume wired means runtime verified
Original F acceptance graph-file parser expects JSON nodes/edges, while E persists HQKGX1 JSONL plus .hqj and read-only query results; adapt F to E actual exchange/query shape before real assessment
Published upstream HANDOFFs explicitly lack owner-machine A index/reset receipts, B real SQLite rows, E running Rust .hqj and D generated wiki on A+B+C data
